risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, but includes extensive forward-looking qualifiers and accounting-estimate caveats. Key risks include declining revenue, customer and Comcast concentration, industry consolidation, technology-transition delays, geopolitical weakness, restructuring needs, and revenue-recognition judgment.
